Make something with your hands
Small, friendly pottery classes for complete beginners.
Clay, glazes and firing are all included.
Book a class

Why people come back

Our studio is a calm place to slow down. You leave each session with a piece you made yourself, and a cup of tea.
  • Wheel throwing
    Centre the clay and throw your first bowls over six evenings.
  • Hand-building
    Pinch, coil and slab techniques, no wheel needed.
Meet the team
Fernhill started in a garden shed with one second-hand wheel. Today we teach eight people at a time in a converted mill.
Classes run on weekday evenings and Saturday mornings.
